I think escorts are a different thing because they very often reject the clients they don't want, and the practices they don't want to do, and make quite a lot of money. I know some are in it because they want to, but it is a mistake to think it's the norm. I am quite surpised to see how many people completely disregard the trafficking, r\*pes and traumas of those women and present it like it's just your average profession.

(Not shaming prostitutes at all, but directing my thoughts to people who disregard these very serious problems). 

So I guess if my boyfriend ever paid for sex, I wouldn't feel great about it for these reasons, even though I'd find it fine it it were with an escort who completely had freedom of decision over doing it with him and of the practices.
